notes.title: Build 39 Update Notes (Mar 15 2023)
notes.content:
-Added online connectivity indicator to main screen.
-Added a connection timeout on initial load. This should prevent users that were getting hangups.
-Our backend service is not supported in all countries, so this should fix issues for users in certain countries not being able to play. You will still have full access to all the campaign levels and features, but will not have access to the Arcade mode if you cannot connect.

notes.title: Build 38 Update Notes (Jan 9 2023)
notes.content:
-Attempted to fix some crashing that has been occurring for some users.
-Arcade completion stat will only increment once per user now, the first time they complete that level.

NOTE: We are aware some users might be hanging on the initial load screen. A potential fix might be to just restart your steam client and try again. Otherwise we are looking into it.

notes.title: Build 37 Update Notes (Jan 8 2023)
notes.content:
-Added steam rich presence information in friends list.
-Updated some button icons to more accurately reflect their usage.
-Updated mouse icons for clarity.
-Added a dedicated "Apply Settings" button in settings menu.
-Updated the layout of the title screen.
-Added button animations across the board.
-Level select scrolls to latest unlocked level when appropriate.

notes.title: Build 36 Update Notes (Jan 7 2023)
notes.content: We've added steam achievements to the game. Once you make any changes or take any action in the game, it should retroactively update and award you everything you've earned already. Thanks!
